integrity: All-size result has a self-contained proof; direct-state enumeration for six sample sizes is corroborative only; cited previous work is acknowledged. No independence claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple bouquets of quadrilaterals, strict open-neighborhood synchronous binary majority with tie retention; periodic census only, no exact basin or sharp transient classification. Novelty cannot be established against all unindexed literature.
title: Exact recurrent-orbit census for majority dynamics on bouquets of squares
